purpose: Prevent 145 source-identified paintings from being mislabelled as high-resolution assets or re-acquiring an already owned 4/5 or 5/5 artwork. First tier each proposed painting by the strength of physical museum identity and artwork page.
operationalInstructions: Before actual retrieval, join confirmed museum accession or object ID to the 281 existing canonical object URLs plus the 266 SHA originals; exact URL mismatch is insufficient to prove unique object, though current source record has no same-title artist/archive match.
Identity risk is a preflight classification, not a scholarly judgment on attribution.
Ambrosiana explicit permission required, no scraping or reuse of site images.
Met/NGA public domain image statuses lead in the lawful image-source queue; still verify physical bytes, non-watermarked fidelity, commercial reuse and image pixel dimensions.
Protect all original objects with existing 4/5 and 5/5 ratings. A 3/5 existing original may be reviewed for an upgraded image only when quality is demonstrably deficient.
Exclude all explicitly scored 0–2 original works from final review, while keeping the artist eligible for newly discovered different works.
No auto-repeat absent a painting-specific user 5/5. The artist ranking doesn't create such a rating.
